title: A finite nominal pass is not a full program-class service theorem
statement: Introduced .5 m, 40x35 mm and .84 kg at E=500 MPa give B1=71.4583333 and B2=93.3333333 N m^2. C=40 N m^2 and S=(200000,200000,700000) N are separately introduced, not implied by E or the circular source specialization. Seventy-five fixed programs are not a probability sample or exhaustive check. Their maximum nominal translation bound is 8.03887350 mm with rotation bound 1.38469467 degrees. The particular leading-eigenvector force aligned with gravity need not maximize six-coordinate response. A uniform sufficient estimate using min(B1,B2,C)=40 and min(S)=200000 gives 13.6708734 mm, above 10 mm. This removes that sufficient certificate; it does not prove actual failure. More specific analysis or different physical rigidities may improve it.
